author: ETA PRIME
description:
Is the Lenovo Legion Go S worth buying over a Steam Deck OLED? In this video, we take a look at a used White Lenovo Legion Go S powered by the AMD Ryzen Z2 GO processor with 32GB of RAM and a 1TB SSD.

Buy a used Legion Go S on eBay: https://ebay.us/n8mcdb

We compare its specs directly against the Steam Deck OLED, walk through its design and software features, test battery life, and benchmark several games—including Cyberpunk 2077, Forza Horizon 5, Red Dead Redemption, and Halo 3.
